name: binalert-monorepo
description: BinAlert — AI-powered waste sorting and municipal waste management platform (frontend + API + AI service)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:web && npm run install:api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix server run prisma:reset && npm --prefix server run db:seed
